description: Add well-controlled mild asthma with occasional albuterol use
presentation: Patient is a 55 year old woman with a history of fecal transplant for Clostridium difficile infection and well-controlled mild asthma with occasional albuterol use. The patient developed an atypical pneumonia with diarrhea and was started on azithromycin after which she had loose and bloody stools. The bloody stools have resolved but she has persistent loose stool. She has no watery stool, abdominal pain, fevers, chills, or other GI symptoms. Do we need to order C. Diff testing for this patient?
